steps: Close January 2025 (Period Closing screen or POST /api/accounting/fiscal-periods/{id}/close).

steps: Have an active approval workflow for BANK_RECONCILIATION.
Start a January reconciliation with a bank-fee adjusting entry dated inside January, fully matched.

bank:A-96c.verify: Repeat steps 1-4 on deployment/dev; after the fix step 4 must answer 409 and the status must stay DRAFT.
